SCENE sc_001 0-45800 EXT. MANOR GROUNDS - BLACKTHORN GARDEN – DUSK
EP13:E1 0-4200 CAMERA: Low-angle macro shot tracking through an impenetrable, menacing thicket of frozen blackthorn briars encrusted with frost.
EP13:E2 0-4000 SOUND: Whistling winter wind and an ominous low brass drone.
EP13:E3 4200-7000 CAMERA: Wide shot looking down from the stone terrace. Gerald and Clarissa stand elevated on the balustrade, while Juliana, Alexander in handcuffs, and the Constable stand before the dense briar garden.
EP13:E4 5100-7000 ACTION: Alexander turns toward Juliana, his manacled hands trembling as he grips her arm.
EP13:E5 5400-10200 ALEXANDER [Pleading, Agonized]: "Juliana, look at those thorns. You cannot do this."
EP13:E6 7000-10800 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Alexander and Juliana facing each other, his chained wrists held between them.
EP13:E7 10800-14200 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana's hooded face, her eyes filled with resolute sorrow.
EP13:E8 12400-13800 JULIANA [Quiet, Unwavering]: "I must."
EP13:E9 14200-18800 CAMERA: Close-up on Alexander, his combat scar stark against his pained expression.
EP13:E10 14400-17300 ALEXANDER [Terrified for Her]: "They will tear your hands apart."
EP13:E11 18800-21000 CAMERA: Low-angle shot looking up at Gerald and Clarissa leaning over the stone balustrade, smirking down with cruel amusement.
EP13:E12 21000-24200 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking up into Alexander's eyes with tender courage.
EP13:E13 22000-23900 JULIANA [Soft, Reassuring]: "I will be fine."
EP13:E14 24200-28400 ALEXANDER [Desperate, Fierce]: "I would rather face the gallows than watch you hurt yourself for me."
EP13:E15 24200-28500 CAMERA: Two-shot framing Alexander leaning down toward Juliana, fighting against his bonds.
EP13:E16 28500-29900 CAMERA: Close-up of Gerald chuckling smugly on the terrace above, crossing his arms.
EP13:E17 29900-36800 CAMERA: Tight close-up of Juliana gently clasping Alexander's handcuffed hands, gazing up at him with unyielding love.
EP13:E18 30800-35800 JULIANA [Emotional, Devoted]: "You stood beside me when everyone else abandoned me. I will not abandon you now."
EP13:E19 36200-39500 ACTION: Juliana releases his hands and turns toward the briar thicket. Alexander stretches out his chained hands, attempting to hold her back, but the Constable restrains him.
EP13:E20 36800-39800 CAMERA: Medium shot behind Juliana as she walks toward the vast expanse of frozen briars.
EP13:E21 37000-38200 CLARISSA [O.S.) (Mocking, Vindictive]: "Careful, sister."
EP13:E22 39800-41600 CAMERA: Low-angle shot of Clarissa smirking down over the carved stone balustrade.
EP13:E23 39900-41500 CLARISSA [Cruel, Sarcastic]: "That garden has swallowed better women than you."
EP13:E24 41600-45800 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Gerald leaning against the balcony beside Clarissa, wearing an arrogant smirk.
EP13:E25 41800-45500 GERALD [Condescending, Arrogant]: "Perhaps the beggar's wife will finally learn what her new life is worth."
SCENE sc_002 45800-118880 EXT. FROZEN BLACKTHORN BRIARS – CONTINUOUS
EP13:E26 45800-47000 ACTION: Juliana drops to her knees in front of the frozen blackthorn branches, steadying her trembling breath.
EP13:E27 45800-47000 CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana kneeling on the frozen soil at the edge of the briars.
EP13:E28 47000-50000 CAMERA: Medium shot of Alexander lunging forward with chained hands raised high, roaring in fury as the Constable grabs him.
EP13:E29 47200-48800 ALEXANDER [Screaming, Panicked]: "Juliana, stop!"

EP13:E32 50000-52000 CAMERA: Eye-level shot looking through the thorny thicket at Juliana crawling deeper into the briars.
EP13:E33 51500-52600 ALEXANDER [Strangled, Weeping]: "Please..."

EP13:E37 54500-55800 JULIANA [Gasping in Pain]: "No..."

EP13:E39 57200-58600 CLARISSA [O.S.) (Gleeful, Derisive]: "Look at her hands."

EP13:E43 62000-67500 CAMERA: Low-angle medium close-up of Gerald shouting down into the garden.
EP13:E44 62200-67000 GERALD [Taunting, Cruel]: "Keep searching, Juliana. Your husband's freedom is somewhere in that garden."
EP13:E45 67500-71200 CAMERA: Macro close-up of a massive blackthorn needle stabbing deep into the back of Juliana's bleeding hand.
EP13:E46 68500-70200 SOUND: Sickening crunch and scrape of thorns slicing through flesh.
EP13:E47 71200-74000 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander struggling in agony, tears forming in his eyes.
EP13:E48 71400-73800 ALEXANDER [Desperate, Choked]: "Please... enough!"

EP13:E52 78500-80500 JULIANA [Screaming in Pain]: "Ah!"

EP13:E60 86500-88800 ALEXANDER [Roaring in Torment]: "Juliana!"
